# Vapi

> Vapi is a developer platform for building voice AI agents that make and receive phone calls, run in the browser, and integrate with custom tools, workflows, and a REST API.

This file mirrors https://docs.vapi.ai/llms.txt. It was generated from the public docs source (https://github.com/VapiAI/docs, commit 88b766822b00, 2026-09-04) on 2026-09-05.
Full page bodies are in llms-full.txt next to this file; the changelog is in llms-changelog.txt; the REST API contract is in openapi.json.

## Documentation

### Get started
- [Introduction](https://docs.vapi.ai/quickstart/introduction): Build voice AI agents that can make and receive phone calls
- [Phone calls](https://docs.vapi.ai/quickstart/phone): Learn to make your first phone call with a voice agent
- [Web calls](https://docs.vapi.ai/quickstart/web): Build voice interfaces and backend integrations using Vapi's Web and Server SDKs
- [Guides](https://docs.vapi.ai/guides): Explore real-world, cloneable examples to build voice agents with Assistants and Squads
- [Composer](https://docs.vapi.ai/composer): Build and configure voice AI agents through natural conversation [pre-release]
- [Vapi CLI](https://docs.vapi.ai/cli): Command-line interface for building voice AI applications faster

### Assistants
- [Assistants quickstart](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/quickstart): Build your first assistant and make a phone call in minutes

#### Core concepts
- [Transient vs permanent configurations](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/concepts/transient-vs-permanent-configurations): Learn to choose between inline and stored assistant configurations

#### Conversation behavior
- [Variables](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/dynamic-variables): Personalize assistant messages with dynamic and default variables
- [Multilingual support](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/multilingual): Enable voice assistants to speak multiple languages fluently
- [Personalization with user information](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/personalization): Add customer-specific information to your voice assistant conversations
- [Voice formatting plan](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/voice-formatting-plan): Format LLM output for natural-sounding speech
- [Flush syntax](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/flush-syntax): Control voice transmission timing for responsive conversations
- [Background messages](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/background-messages): Silently update chat history with background messages
- [Idle messages](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/idle-messages): Keep users engaged during conversation pauses
- [Assistant hooks](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/assistant-hooks): Automate actions on call events and interruptions
- [Call timeout settings](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/call-timeout-settings): End inactive calls and limit the total duration of each call.
- [Keypad input settings](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/keypad-input-settings): Configure how an assistant collects keypad input from callers.
- [End call phrases](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/end-call-phrases): End calls when an assistant says a configured phrase.
- [Background speech denoising](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/background-speech-denoising): Filter out noise and background speech while users are talking
- [Pronunciation dictionaries](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/pronunciation-dictionaries): Control how your AI assistant pronounces specific words and phrases
- [Email address reading](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/email-address-reading): Get your voice agent to collect, read back, and confirm email addresses clearly

#### Model configurations
- [Speech configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/speech-configuration): Control when your assistant starts and stops speaking
- [Voice pipeline configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/voice-pipeline-configuration): Configure start and stop speaking plans for natural conversation flow
- [Voice fallback configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/voice-fallback-plan): Configure fallback voices that activate automatically if your primary voice fails.
- [Transcriber fallback configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/transcriber-fallback-plan): Configure fallback transcribers that activate automatically if your primary transcriber fails.
- [OpenAI Realtime](https://docs.vapi.ai/openai-realtime): Build voice assistants with OpenAI's native speech-to-speech models for ultra-low latency conversations
- [Provider Keys](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/provider-keys): Bring your own API keys to Vapi.

#### Versioning
- [Versioning with assistants](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/versioning/versioning-assistants): Publish, view history, and restore versions of an assistant
- [Versioning with tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/versioning/versioning-tools): Publish, view history, and restore versions of a tool
- [How versioning works with assistants and tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/versioning/versioning-with-assistants-and-tools): Choose the tool versions an assistant uses and understand how restores affect them

#### Model Intelligence
- [Model Intelligence for transcribers, models, and voices](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/overview): Choose assistant components with curated Model Presets and Performance Metrics.
- [Model Presets for transcribers, models, and voices](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/presets): Configure an assistant's transcriber, model, and voice with one preset.
- [Performance metrics and methodology reference](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/metrics-methodology): See how Vapi sources and calculates latency, cost, and quality metrics.
- [How voice agent component costs and estimates work](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/understanding-cost): Learn what drives costs across the transcriber, model, and voice.
- [How voice-to-voice latency works in voice agents](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/model-intelligence/understanding-latency): Learn what voice-to-voice latency measures and why capable models respond more slowly.

#### Tools
- [API Request Tool vs Function Tool](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request-vs-function): Choose API Request for direct HTTP APIs and Function for Vapi tool-calls webhooks.
- [Default Tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/default-tools): Adding Transfer Call, End Call, Dial Keypad, and API Request capabilities to your assistants.

##### API Request Tool
- [API Request Tool quickstart](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/quickstart): Create a coffee-order assistant that calls an HTTP API during an inbound phone call.
- [Customize API Request Tool requests](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/configuration): Add headers, static fields, Liquid values, and authentication while keeping model-generated and server-resolved data separate.
- [Handle API Request Tool latency and retries](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/reliability): Set request timeouts, keep callers informed, and retry only requests that are safe to repeat.
- [Handle API Request Tool responses and errors](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/response-handling): Design response contracts, recover from failures, and inspect tool results without misleading the caller.
- [Use API Request Tool response data](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/api-request/response-data): Let the model answer from the current result or extract values for later tool calls.

##### Transfer call tool
- [Configure blind transfer modes](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/transfer-call/blind-transfer): Connect a caller immediately, with an optional summary in a SIP header.
- [Configure warm transfer modes](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/transfer-call/warm-transfer): Introduce a caller with a message, summary, or TwiML before connecting.
- [Configure assistant-based warm transfer](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/assistant-based-warm-transfer): Let an AI assistant introduce a caller before connecting a transfer.
- [Voicemail Tool](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/voicemail-tool): Learn how to use the assistant-controlled voicemail tool for flexible voicemail handling
- [Custom (Function) Tools](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/custom-tools): Create custom tools, including Function Tools that connect your assistant to server-side logic.
- [Client-side Tools (Web SDK)](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/client-side-websdk): Handle tool-calls in the browser without a server URL
- [Tool rejection plan](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/tool-rejection-plan): Prevent unintended tool calls using conditions based on conversation state
- [Static variables and aliases](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/static-variables-and-aliases): Inject server-controlled values into tool calls without LLM involvement, and chain values across tool calls deterministically.
- [Custom tools troubleshooting](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/custom-tools-troubleshooting): Resolve common issues with custom tool integrations
- [Handoff tool](/squads/handoff)

##### External tools
- [Google Calendar Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/google-calendar): Connect your assistant to Google Calendar for seamless appointment scheduling and availability checking.
- [Google Sheets Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/google-sheets): Connect your assistant to Google Sheets for seamless data entry.
- [Slack Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/slack): Connect your assistant to Slack for seamless message sending.
- [GoHighLevel Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/go-high-level): Connect your assistant to GoHighLevel for seamless appointment scheduling, contact creation, and availability checking.

##### Knowledge retrieval

- [Custom Knowledge Base](https://docs.vapi.ai/knowledge-base/custom-knowledge-base): Create and implement your own knowledge base server for full control over document retrieval
- [Tool Arguments Encryption](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/encryption): Learn to encrypt tool arguments and protect sensitive data
- [Keywords and keyterm prompting](https://docs.vapi.ai/customization/custom-keywords): Boost STT accuracy for domain words and phrases

#### Examples
- [Appointment scheduling assistant](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/examples/appointment-scheduling): Build an AI receptionist that books, reschedules, and cancels appointments using Assistants and tools

- [Creating Free Phone Numbers](https://docs.vapi.ai/free-telephony): Creating free phone numbers on the Vapi platform.
- [Inbound SMS](https://docs.vapi.ai/phone-numbers/inbound-sms): Let agents auto-start chats from incoming text messages (US only)

#### Telephony integrations
- [Import number from Twilio](https://docs.vapi.ai/phone-numbers/import-twilio): Import a new or existing number from Twilio
- [Import number from Telnyx](https://docs.vapi.ai/telnyx): Import and use your Telnyx numbers with Vapi
- [Import a number from DIDWW](https://docs.vapi.ai/phone-numbers/didww): Purchase or select a DIDWW number, route it through your inbound trunk, and import it into Vapi as a BYO SIP trunk number.

#### SIP integration
- [SIP introduction](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip): Make SIP calls to your Vapi assistant
- [SIP Trunking](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/sip-trunk): How to integrate your SIP provider with Vapi
- [SIP networking and firewall configuration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/sip-networking): Learn to configure your network to allow SIP signalling and media traffic with Vapi

##### Providers

- [DIDWW SIP integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/didww): Connect DIDWW SIP trunks to Vapi so your assistants can receive calls, place outbound calls, and transfer active calls with SIP REFER.
- [didlogic SIP integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/didlogic): Connect didlogic SIP trunks and phone numbers to Vapi
- [Zadarma SIP Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/zadarma): How to integrate SIP Zadarma to Vapi
- [Plivo SIP Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/plivo): Learn to connect your Plivo SIP trunk to Vapi for inbound and outbound calls
- [Amazon Chime SDK SIP Integration](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/amazon-chime): How to integrate Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector with Vapi
- [Troubleshoot SIP trunk credential errors](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/troubleshoot-sip-trunk-credential-errors): Learn to resolve gateway creation failures when setting up a BYO SIP trunk
- [Troubleshoot SIP response codes](https://docs.vapi.ai/advanced/sip/troubleshoot-sip-response-codes): Identify where a SIP request failed and what to check in Vapi, your provider, and your SIP infrastructure

### Calls

#### Place calls
- [Outbound Calling](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/outbound-calling): Learn how to send outbound calls from Vapi.
- [WebSocket Transport](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/websocket-transport): Stream audio directly via WebSockets for real-time, bidirectional communication

#### In-call control
- [Live Call Control](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-features)
- [Customer Join Timeout](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/customer-join-timeout): Configure web call join timeout for better success rates
- [Voicemail Detection](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/voicemail-detection)

##### Transfer calls
- [Transfer call tool](https://docs.vapi.ai/tools/transfer-call): Route an active phone call to a phone number or SIP URI.
- [Configure assistant-based warm transfer](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/assistant-based-warm-transfer): Let an AI assistant introduce a caller before connecting a transfer.
- [Dynamic call transfers](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-dynamic-transfers): Route calls to different destinations based on real-time conversation context and external data.
- [Call Handling with Vapi and Twilio](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-handling-with-vapi-and-twilio)
- [Debug call forwarding drops](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/troubleshoot-call-forwarding-drops): Learn to troubleshoot calls that drop immediately after initiating transfer
- [Call queue management with Twilio](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-queue-management): Handle high-volume calls with Twilio queues when hitting Vapi concurrency limits
- [Understanding Call Concurrency](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-concurrency): Plan, monitor, and scale simultaneous Vapi calls
- [Call ended reasons](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/call-ended-reason): All possible call ended reason codes and what they mean.
- [Troubleshoot call errors](https://docs.vapi.ai/calls/troubleshoot-call-errors): Learn to diagnose failed calls based on what the caller experienced.

#### Call insights
- [Call analysis](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/call-analysis): Summarize and evaluate calls automatically
- [Call recording, logging and transcribing](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/call-recording): Record, log, and transcribe calls using artifact plans
- [Retrieve call artifacts](https://docs.vapi.ai/assistants/retrieve-call-artifacts): Download recordings and call logs from Vapi's private storage using authenticated, short-lived URLs.

- [Deepgram](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/transcriber/deepgram): Use Deepgram speech-to-text models in Vapi.
- [ElevenLabs](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/transcriber/elevenlabs): Use ElevenLabs for speech-to-text in Vapi.
- [Gladia](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/transcriber/gladia): Use Gladia for real-time speech-to-text in your Vapi voice agent.
- [Google](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/transcriber/google): Use Google for speech-to-text in Vapi.
- [OpenAI](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/transcriber/openai): Use OpenAI for speech-to-text in Vapi.
- [Soniox](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/transcriber/soniox): Configure real-time, multilingual speech-to-text for Vapi assistants.
- [Speechmatics](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/transcriber/speechmatics): Use Speechmatics for real-time multilingual speech-to-text in Vapi.
- [Talkscriber](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/transcriber/talkscriber): Configure Talkscriber real-time speech-to-text for your Vapi voice agent.
- [xAI](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/transcriber/xai): Use xAI for speech-to-text in Vapi.

##### Large language models
- [Anthropic](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/anthropic): Use Anthropic's Claude models as the language model for your Vapi voice agent.
- [Anthropic Bedrock](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/anthropic-bedrock): Use Anthropic Claude models via AWS Bedrock with your own AWS resources
- [Anyscale](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/anyscale): Connect Anyscale and configure a model available to your account.
- [Azure OpenAI](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/azure-openai): Use custom Azure OpenAI instances with your own rate limits and configurations
- [Cerebras](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/cerebras): Connect your Cerebras account to use Cerebras models in Vapi.
- [DeepInfra](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/deepinfra): Connect DeepInfra and configure any model available to your account.
- [DeepSeek](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/deepseek): Connect your DeepSeek account to use DeepSeek models in Vapi.
- [Google](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/gemini): Use Google Gemini as your Vapi voice agent's language model.
- [Groq](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/groq): Use Groq's low-latency models as the language model for your Vapi voice agent.
- [Inflection AI](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/inflection-ai): Connect your Inflection AI account to use Inflection models in Vapi.
- [MiniMax](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/minimax): Use MiniMax as your Vapi voice agent's language model.
- [Mistral](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/mistral): Use Mistral's models as the language model for your Vapi voice agent.
- [OpenAI](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/openai): Use OpenAI GPT models with your Vapi voice agent.
- [OpenRouter](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/openrouter): Connect OpenRouter and configure any model available to your account.
- [Perplexity](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/perplexity): Connect Perplexity and configure a Sonar model available to your account.
- [Together AI](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/togetherai): Connect Together AI and configure any model available to your account.
- [xAI](https://docs.vapi.ai/providers/model/xai): Use xAI Grok models with your Vapi voice agent.

- [Zero Data Retention (ZDR)](https://docs.vapi.ai/security-and-privacy/zero-data-retention): Enable Zero Data Retention so Vapi processes calls without storing recordings, transcripts, or logs.
- [PCI Compliance](https://docs.vapi.ai/security-and-privacy/pci): Ensure secure payment data handling while using Vapi’s voice assistant platform.
- [Proxy server guide](https://docs.vapi.ai/security-and-privacy/proxy-server): Keep assistant configs and API keys on your backend. Route Web SDK calls through your proxy.

## API Reference

### API reference
- [API reference overview](https://docs.vapi.ai/api-reference)
- [OpenAPI spec (JSON)](https://api.vapi.ai/api-json)
- [Swagger UI](https://api.vapi.ai/api)
- Base URL: https://api.vapi.ai
- Local copy of the spec: docs/vapi/openapi.json

#### Assistants
- POST /assistant: Create Assistant
- GET /assistant: List Assistants
- POST /assistant/background-sound/validate: Validate Background Sound URL
- GET /assistant/{id}: Get Assistant
- PATCH /assistant/{id}: Update Assistant
- DELETE /assistant/{id}: Delete Assistant

#### Squads
- POST /squad: Create Squad
- GET /squad: List Squads
- GET /squad/{id}: Get Squad
- PATCH /squad/{id}: Update Squad
- DELETE /squad/{id}: Delete Squad

#### Calls
- POST /call: Create Call
- GET /call: List Calls
- GET /call/{id}: Get Call
- PATCH /call/{id}: Update Call
- DELETE /call/{id}: Delete Call
- GET /call/{id}/mono-recording: Download Call Mono Recording
- GET /call/{id}/stereo-recording: Download Call Stereo Recording
- GET /call/{id}/video-recording: Download Call Video Recording
- GET /call/{id}/customer-recording: Download Call Customer Recording
- GET /call/{id}/assistant-recording: Download Call Assistant Recording
- GET /call/{id}/pcap: Download Call Packet Capture (pcap)
- GET /call/{id}/call-logs: Download Call Logs

#### Chats
- GET /chat: List Chats
- POST /chat: Create Chat
- GET /chat/{id}: Get Chat
- DELETE /chat/{id}: Delete Chat
- POST /chat/responses: Create Chat (OpenAI Compatible)

#### Campaigns
- POST /campaign: Create Campaign
- GET /campaign: List Campaigns
- POST /v2/campaign: Create Campaign V2
- GET /v2/campaign: List Campaigns V2
- GET /v2/campaign/{id}: Get Campaign V2
- PATCH /v2/campaign/{id}: Update Campaign
- DELETE /v2/campaign/{id}: Delete Campaign
- GET /campaign/{id}: Get Campaign
- PATCH /campaign/{id}: Update Campaign
- DELETE /campaign/{id}: Delete Campaign
- GET /v2/campaign/{id}/contacts: Get Campaign V2 Contacts

#### Sessions
- POST /session: Create Session
- GET /session: List Sessions
- GET /session/{id}: Get Session
- PATCH /session/{id}: Update Session
- DELETE /session/{id}: Delete Session

#### Phone Numbers
- POST /phone-number: Create Phone Number
- GET /phone-number: List Phone Numbers
- GET /v2/phone-number: List Phone Numbers
- GET /phone-number/{id}: Get Phone Number
- PATCH /phone-number/{id}: Update Phone Number
- DELETE /phone-number/{id}: Delete Phone Number

#### Tools
- POST /tool: Create Tool
- GET /tool: List Tools
- GET /tool/{id}: Get Tool
- PATCH /tool/{id}: Update Tool
- DELETE /tool/{id}: Delete Tool

#### Files
- POST /file: Upload File
- GET /file: List Files
- GET /file/{id}: Get File
- PATCH /file/{id}: Update File
- DELETE /file/{id}: Delete File

#### Knowledge Bases V2
- POST /v2/knowledge-base: Create a Knowledge Base V2
- GET /v2/knowledge-base: List Knowledge Bases V2
- GET /v2/knowledge-base/{id}/file: List files in a Knowledge Base V2
- POST /v2/knowledge-base/{id}/file: Attach and ingest a file
- DELETE /v2/knowledge-base/{id}/file/{fileId}: Detach a file
- POST /v2/knowledge-base/{id}/file/{fileId}/retry: Retry indexing a failed file
- PATCH /v2/knowledge-base/{id}: Update a Knowledge Base V2
- GET /v2/knowledge-base/{id}: Get a Knowledge Base V2
- DELETE /v2/knowledge-base/{id}: Delete a Knowledge Base V2

#### Structured Outputs
- GET /structured-output: List Structured Outputs
- POST /structured-output: Create Structured Output
- GET /structured-output/{id}: Get Structured Output
- PATCH /structured-output/{id}: Update Structured Output
- DELETE /structured-output/{id}: Delete Structured Output
- POST /structured-output/run: Run Structured Output

#### Simulation Personalities
- POST /eval/simulation/personality: Create Personality
- GET /eval/simulation/personality: List Personalities
- GET /eval/simulation/personality/{id}: Get Personality
- PATCH /eval/simulation/personality/{id}: Update Personality
- DELETE /eval/simulation/personality/{id}: Delete Personality

#### Simulation Scenarios

- GET /eval/simulation/scenario/{id}: Get Scenario
- PATCH /eval/simulation/scenario/{id}: Update Scenario
- DELETE /eval/simulation/scenario/{id}: Delete Scenario

#### Simulation Runs
- POST /eval/simulation/run: Create Simulation Run
- GET /eval/simulation/run: List Simulation Runs
- GET /eval/simulation/run/{id}: Get Simulation Run
- PATCH /eval/simulation/run/{id}: Cancel Simulation Run
- GET /eval/simulation/run/{id}/item: List Simulation Run Items
- GET /eval/simulation/run/{id}/item/{itemId}: Get Simulation Run Item
- PATCH /eval/simulation/run/{id}/item/{itemId}: Cancel Simulation Run Item
- POST /eval/simulation/run/{id}/item/{itemId}/generate: Generate Improvement Suggestions

#### Simulation Run Items
- GET /eval/simulation/run/{id}/item: List Simulation Run Items
- GET /eval/simulation/run/{id}/item/{itemId}: Get Simulation Run Item
- PATCH /eval/simulation/run/{id}/item/{itemId}: Cancel Simulation Run Item
- POST /eval/simulation/run/{id}/item/{itemId}/generate: Generate Improvement Suggestions

#### Simulation Suites

- GET /eval/simulation/suite: List Simulation Suites
- POST /eval/simulation/suite/{id}/duplicate: Duplicate simulation suite
- GET /eval/simulation/suite/{id}: Get Simulation Suite
- PATCH /eval/simulation/suite/{id}: Update Simulation Suite
- DELETE /eval/simulation/suite/{id}: Delete Simulation Suite
